Uttarakhand Minister Rekha Arya Accuses Husband of Conspiracy to Murder

Uttarakhand minister Rekha Arya has filed a First Information Report (FIR) against her husband, Girdhari Lal Sahu. Arya alleges that her husband conspired to murder her and also accused him of bigamy. The FIR was reportedly triggered by an audio recording.
